Container.Name: turkushan-auth
Container.Overview: Self-hosted login portal (forward auth) for your subdomains behind Nginx Proxy Manager. People register their own account, you approve who may open which site in the admin panel, and one login works on all subdomains (SSO cookie). Per site you choose: approval required or open to any logged-in user, and whether a verified email is required. Single container, SQLite database in /data, no extra services. Includes an admin panel with a ready-to-paste NPM config per site, email verification and password reset via any SMTP provider (Resend recommended), and Discord notifications. Guide: https://github.com/turkushan490/turkushan-auth/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: auth sso login forward-auth nginx proxy manager npm auth_request tinyauth authelia
Container.Requires: Nginx Proxy Manager (or nginx with auth_request) and a domain with HTTPS.
Container.Changes: Admin panel, forward auth, per-site approval and verified-email rules, email (verify + password reset), Discord notifications, reset-password recovery command.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port Nginx Proxy Manager uses to reach the portal.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: Public URL of the portal, e.g. https://auth.example.com

Config.Name: ADMIN_USER
Config.Description: Admin account created on first start.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Admin password: at least 6 characters, with 1 capital letter and 1 symbol (e.g. ! @ # ?).

Config.Name: COOKIE_DOMAIN
Config.Description: Optional. Cookie domain shared by all protected subdomains. Empty = derived from APP_URL (auth.example.com gives .example.com).

Config.Name: PORTAL_INTERNAL_URL
Config.Description: Optional. How Nginx Proxy Manager reaches this container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3010. Filled into the nginx snippets the admin panel generates.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: IPs/CIDRs of your proxy. Client IP headers are only trusted from these. Default covers Docker networks.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional (min 32 characters). Empty = generated once and stored in /data/secret.
